# TAO (JUNO-TAO), arXiv:2610.23331v1, Fig. 26: shape templates of the energy-leakage response, used to build
# TAO_Fig26_leakage_matrix_smoothed.txt and read by tao_leakage.jl.
# g_k(delta) is the probability density (per MeV) of delta = E_vis - E_peak(E_true), where
# E_peak = E_true * f_e+(E_true) is the full-containment peak. Each template integrates to 1 (sum * 0.01 = 1).
# Templates are stacked from the pixel extraction (count-weighted) in the E_true bands below. The tail
# (delta < -0.01 MeV) is smoothed with a 0.02-MeV Gaussian using normalised convolution with the
# full-containment spike masked out, so the spike does not leak into the neighbouring tail bins; the spike
# (|delta| < 0.01 MeV) and delta > 0 are kept as stacked.
# Version 2: the first version smoothed across the spike, which created an artificial secondary bump at
# delta = -0.035 MeV (about +35% over the stacked value).
#
# BAND_CENTRES_MEV 1.3363 2.0765 2.9963 3.9606 5.0828 6.7166
# Bands (MeV): 1.022-1.5, 1.5-2.5, 2.5-3.5, 3.5-4.5, 4.5-6.0, 6.0-11.5
# Bin width: 0.01 MeV; delta from -3.00 to +0.06 MeV.
#
